newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mexico trade minister sees surplus for 1997 - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Mexico trade minister sees surplus for 1997 - RFTV.

text.p: Mexican Trade Minister Herminio Blanco said on Monday he expected the country to show a trade surplus this year despite growth in imports, notably capital goods.

"The last data we have for April, we had more than 30 percent growth on the importation of capital goods. However, even with that drive on imports, we will have this year a surplus on the trade account," Blanco told Reuters Financial Television.
Blanco, in Paris for the annual meeting of the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development, said he did not expect monthly trade figures in the second half of 1997 to show deficits.
"I expect the dynamic of exports to continue. We will see this year an export performance of at least $110 billion. I expect also growth in imports but the trade figures will be in surplus."
Blanco said he expected a positive balance at the end of the year "and I would expect to see that around five billion", he said.
